summary.intent: Fix a lint failure on PR #485 (feat/api-unpin-integrity), then resolve all CodeRabbit review threads on that PR, run a simplify pass on the changed code, run /secure-phase for Phase 42, and handle a second round of CodeRabbit comments after the push.
summary.outcome: Lint fixed and CI turned green; 6 CodeRabbit threads from round 1 fully resolved with code changes and replies; test ordering assertion added; simplify pass confirmed the code was already clean; Phase 42 SECURITY.md created (29 threats, 0 open) and pushed to the PR branch; round-2 CodeRabbit review fixes applied and commit staged but not yet fully verified at transcript end.

repo: apps/web vitest include glob is `**/*.test.ts` only — `.spec.ts` files are silently excluded from CI; delete.service.spec.ts was never running until renamed to .test.ts
Automated GSD/Entire executor commits intentionally bypass the husky pre-commit hook (--no-verify-style), so prettier/eslint auto-fixes don't run; CI eslint is the backstop
Running `openapi:generate` standalone skips the `lint:fix` step that full `api:generate` runs, producing ~700 lines of array-formatting noise in openapi.json — revert and let CI validate instead
gsd-commit-helper reports `committed: false / commit_failed` as a false negative; always verify with `git log` rather than retrying
check-api-client.sh pre-commit hook only blocks if openapi.json has uncommitted changes — internal-only controller edits (no route/DTO change) are safe without regen
CI `pnpm typecheck` only covers apps/web (`tsc -b`) + shared packages; apps/api specs are not typechecked by CI (only covered by nest build / ts-jest)
scripts/backfill-pinned-cids.ts is a root-level ad-hoc ts-node script not included in any tsconfig — not CI-typechecked
parseKuboPinLs is used only by the destructive backfill script, not the tolerant drift-report path — fail-closed behavior is appropriate there
recordPin uses orIgnore() INSERT, so it only throws on genuine DB errors, not conflicts — the orphaned-pin window is narrow and cleaned up by drift-report + backfill

The gsd-security-auditor subagent overstepped its constraints and appended 54 lines to the repo-root SECURITY.md (the project vuln-disclosure policy from #482) instead of writing to the phase dir — requires manual revert
AbortSignal.timeout() is already established as the fetch-timeout pattern (migration.processor.ts precedent); ES2022 target in tsconfig.base supports it

code.finding: guardedUnpin has two callers with different audit needs: line 126 (internal rollback) should suppress the cross-user metric/warn, line 149 (/unpin endpoint) should keep auditing — resolved by adding optional suppressCrossUserAudit option
Advisory-lock ordering test asserts hashtext() before pg_advisory_xact_lock(); merging into one query required reordering the mock branch checks or the test breaks

fetchQuota has ~5 fire-and-forget callers; making it reject would cause unhandled rejections across all of them — returning a success boolean preserves the no-throw contract while still surfacing failures to awaited callers
Controller spec asserts exact guardedUnpin args — adding the options param to the call site required updating this assertion to include the new suppress flag
Test named 'then fetchQuota in order' only asserted it was called, not its position in callOrder; callOrder[2] assertion was missing
parseKuboPinLs was silently skipping malformed NDJSON lines; backfill is destructive so fail-closed (throw on parse error) is the correct behavior here

workflow: Verify CodeRabbit suggested fixes for security regressions before applying — thread [3] suggested making guardedUnpin unpin when no owned row exists, which would have reintroduced the cross-tenant vulnerability the entire phase was built to prevent
For shared-method return-type changes, enumerate all callers first (grep) before deciding the fix strategy — the blast-radius check changed the fetchQuota fix approach entirely
Write commit messages to a temp file to avoid shell-escaping issues with backticks in heredocs
zsh 1-based arrays caused two reply posts to miss their targets when iterating an array; use explicit variable names instead of array indices for reliability
zsh doesn't word-split unquoted variable in --include=; use xargs or quoted globs for multi-file grep/lint
Running the exact CI typecheck command locally (pnpm typecheck) is more reliable than inferring what it covers — the api and web have separate typecheck scopes

friction: gsd-commit-helper false negative (`committed: false`) requires always cross-checking with `git log` to confirm commits landed

The gsd-security-auditor subagent clobbered the repo-root SECURITY.md (pre-existing security disclosure policy) despite the constraint to not modify implementation files — required manual detection via `git status` and revert
openapi:generate standalone creates ~700 lines of array-formatting noise vs the committed prettier-formatted file — misleadingly looks like real spec drift until inspected
zsh glob expansion silently ate `--include` patterns in grep; needed two attempts to get blast-radius searches working
zsh 1-based array indexing caused two of the six GitHub thread replies to miss, requiring a separate follow-up post
CodeRabbit's outside-diff comments (like the test ordering assertion) don't create resolvable review threads — fixes must be applied without a thread to close
open_items: 4 copies of the fetch-timeout pattern now exist (tee, delegated-routing, migration.processor, pending-unpin.processor) — extract to a shared fetchWithTimeout utility in a future cleanup PR
suppressCrossUserAudit boolean on guardedUnpin is a candidate for an intent enum if a third caller type emerges
Round-2 CodeRabbit review fixes were committed but not yet pushed/verified at transcript end — confirm CI green on that commit
http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts has a pre-existing NestJS export mismatch TypeScript error (not CI-visible, not introduced by this work, but present in the repo)
scripts/backfill-pinned-cids.ts is not included in any tsconfig — consider adding it to the root tsconfig or the api tsconfig so it gets CI type coverage
